title: Calibrated cross-experiment reported-pain inference from complete laser-evoked EEG epochs
disposition_reason: Complete nominal-cohort scoring and common numerical condition packets are delivered despite stale original no-scorer wording. The normalized ledger/epoch producer, physical energy and marker joins, unique-person linkage, competent references and actual model context/transport remain unqualified.

scientific_target.question: After two chronological calibration trials, can EEG improve prediction of a new person’s subsequent recorded intensity reports beyond delivered energy and context when the complete experiment is held out?
scientific_target.known_answer: Recorded subjective pain-intensity rating on[0,10], retaining zero and decimal values; predicted median minimizes the registered absolute error.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original trial report field joined to authentic EEG and chronology. Unpleasantness and calibrated intensity-category names are distinct fields.
scientific_target.case_unit: One eligible post-calibration trial with a complete 3-second EEG epoch,8 training support trials and 2 person calibration trials.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Participant within experiment until cross-experiment identity aliases are reconciled; nine experiments are heterogeneous transfer units.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Offline processed-epoch prediction with small explicit calibration. Incremental EEG information requires a paired energy/context comparator.
exclusions: Objective pain, clinical diagnosis or nociceptive mechanism.
Pre-report neural specificity until epoch end/report onset and marker shifts are authenticated.
Independent-person or contamination-resistant generalization from unresolved reuse/public datasets.

inputs: Complete source-defined[-1,+2]second epoch for query/support/calibration, every EEG channel with units/labels/coordinates and missing masks.
Prospective common 30 Hz-bandlimited 100 Hz representation at 0.01 µV integer quantization; current packets consume normalized epochs, not raw preprocessing.
Actual delivered energy if available, side, device/reference and rating protocol, identical across modes and energy comparator.
forbidden_inputs: Query intensity/unpleasantness, answer-bearing EEG.event/epoch fields, rating/power-sorted ERP averages and source filenames.
Mean held-person outcomes, future reports, other held queries, target-derived QC or source lookup.
Calibrated label 7/10 treated as measured Joules or present-trial answer.
observation_contract.case_identity: Packet constructor derives opaque HMAC trial keys from frozen canonical IDs and handles alias-group purging. It requires 678 nominal people with exact experiment counts 26,29,39,30,65,95,142,223,29; historical completeness and biological linkage remain external.
observation_contract.split: Nine leave-one-experiment-out folds; 8 training supports selected by salted hash, exactly first 2 eligible chronological trials/person calibrate, every later eligible trial queried with fresh state. Repeated people/aliases must be purged across fold boundaries.
observation_contract.coverage: Scorer/packet source validates entire declared 678-person/nineexperiment ledger and all ledger trials. Actual eligible trial census, real epochs and complete model-context fit are not authenticated.

primary.name: Experiment-macro reported-intensity mean absolute error
primary.aggregation: Trial mean per person, person mean per experiment, equal mean over all 9 experiments. Report 678 nominal-person-weighted alternative separately.
primary.rationale: Measures the subjective known answer without allowing large experiments or successful-output subsets to dominate.

secondary: Paired energy/context-reference MAE reduction at person, experiment and overall levels.
Within-person Spearman correlation with constant/invalid cases explicitly undefined.
Optional 80 percent interval coverage/width with supplied and required counts, never selective coverage as whole-assay calibration.
Device strata and all 9 experiment results.

comparators.name: Support/calibration medians
comparators.inputs: Same 10 labeled examples; report target-person 2-trial median separately.
comparators.procedure: Fixed median predictors with no EEG.

comparators.name: Energy/context ridge
comparators.inputs: Same 10 examples and actual energy/side/protocol fields.
comparators.procedure: Prospective fixed lambda=1 ridge with train/support-only centering and missing indicators; complete trusted comparator must be valid for every query.

comparators.name: Waveform nearest-support and physiology ridge
comparators.procedure: Freeze channel/mask distance or signed all-channel 150–350 ms/250–600 ms means plus baseline variance and lambda=1 ridge. These design comparators are not implemented by the packet/scorer source.

nuisance_controls: Same-support context-only, EEG-only and joint comparisons; missing actual energy blocks claims beyond physical intensity.
Baseline-only and event-shift controls, montage permutation and physical-unit scale checks.
Reconcile both 100 ms marker corrections, whole-session ICA/QC lineage and report-onset motor contamination.
Retain full source channels and epoch; no peak-only replacement or context-cap truncation.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired participant-cluster resampling within experiments after reuse grouping, all 9 experiment effects reported; conditional convenience-cohort inference. Current scorer does not implement bootstrap.
evaluation.failure_policy: Each missing/duplicate/malformed/nonfinite/out-of-range required prediction receives loss 10; invalid optional quantiles invalidate that record. Unknown extra IDs fail output validity without erasing valid required cases. Defective trusted target/comparator refuses; no candidate penalty inflates comparator gains.

implementation.scorer_target: Recorded intensity prediction, not copying rating-sorted source ERPs. Actual loss 10 and complete experiment-macro MAE logic are implemented; packet builder enforces support/calibration construction on supplied normalized operands.
implementation.delivered_scope: Standard-library full-assay scorer and common numeric packet constructor with alias purge, target redaction and tokenizer callback. No source EEG epoch extractor/filter or model runner.
missing: Authenticate nine-cohort trial/participant lineage, EEG/target chronology, actual delivered energy and complete epoch preparation.
Freeze/validate actual 30 Hz/100 Hz transform and all-channel masks, two marker shifts and representation residuals.
Fit matched competent references, verify largest full packet using selected real tokenizer, and enforce fresh query execution.
implementation.execution_evidence: Existing generated controls exercise complete nominal population, zero/decimal labels, failure penalties, aliases and byte equality. Capacity tests using fake counters are not real model tokenization; no authentic score or model trial is claimed.

direct_observation.representation: Common complete numeric EEG packet of 10 labeled examples plus query, with optional identical waveform rendering only if qualified.
direct_observation.boundary: No tools or extra source bank; unqualified authentic epoch producer and real-context capacity prevent an executed claim.
missing: Authentic epochs, real tokenizer capacity and model delivery.
Participant execution controller for this mode. The condition-packets owner-side common numeric packet constructor prepares shared evidence but does not run this condition.

typed_viewer.representation: A restricted full-channel waveform viewer could expose the same complete packet.
typed_viewer.boundary: Optional fixed rendering is not a typed viewer; no metadata query may reveal current rating or other held trials.
missing: Typed action protocol, restricted renderer and answer collection.

tool_assisted.representation: Numerical investigation of exactly the common 10 support/calibration-plus-query packet.
tool_assisted.boundary: No external pretrained decoder or extra training corpus in primary comparison; no persistent query state.
missing: Enforced tool/runtime limits, authentic packets and model transport.
Participant execution controller for this mode. The condition-packets owner-side common numeric packet constructor prepares shared evidence but does not run this condition.

frozen_program.representation: Same packet and median/quantile submission ABI for a frozen per-fold predictor.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze before held-experiment query; case-time fit uses only 10 supplied labeled examples.
missing: Programme executor, source/representation qualification and fitted references.
Participant execution controller for this mode. The condition-packets owner-side common numeric packet constructor prepares shared evidence but does not run this condition.

evidence.supports: Preserved source-backed registration, prospective scientific design and original exposure limitations; current implementation changes are described separately.
grade parses candidate before trusted targets, retains all query denominators and penalty 10, then computes person/experiment macroMAE.
Actual 678 nominal-person/nine-experiment support, decimal intensity target, no authentic EEG extractor or causal claim.
PreparedAssay validates complete ledger, purges identities/aliases, selects support without label-based ranking and emits common numeric packets.
Packets preserve all channel/time operands under explicit representation, actual-tokenizer capacity remains required and model execution absent.

evidence.locator: Collection paper and per-study metadata as retained in original source audit
evidence.supports: Nineexperiments,678 nominal participant records, reported pain intensity, devices and no-intervention restriction.

evidence.locator: Pinned official technical-validation code audited in registration
evidence.supports: Rating/power-sorted epoch averages are retrospective validation outputs, not a held-out prediction reference.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: The inspected source carries construction and generated software-control evidence. No neural programme pilot among the four historical EEG/sleep attempts is attributed to this registration, and no model or human outcome is added here.
excluded_claims: Objective pain, clinical diagnosis or nociceptive mechanism.
Pre-report neural specificity until epoch end/report onset and marker shifts are authenticated.
Independent-person or contamination-resistant generalization from unresolved reuse/public datasets.
Author rating-sorted ERP scripts as competent prediction baseline.

summary: Correct original stale no-scorer/no-runner conflation: numerical scoring and identical packet construction exist, authentic epoch preparation and execution do not.
Preserve subjective decimal intensity target and exact nine-experiment macro denominator/failure policy.
Separate actual physical energy from calibrated rating labels and direct numeric packets from absent typed viewer.

A shared complete packet constructor is preparation source, not a direct-answer, tool-investigator or frozen-program controller; all three modes remain not delivered despite implemented identical evidence bytes.
revision.source_review: Reused the preserved registration primary-source audit and inspected the listed actual implementation paths. No authentic numerical payload or protected label was opened; no model was run.
